numeric_target_author: Implementation team; operationalization, not an owner-supplied number
initial_hp_derivation: 1 + first digest byte modulo8 of SHA256('mortal-balance/1.0.0|initial-hp|' + phase + '|' + index); separate fixture domain, not action RNG
secondary_stress: Two identical foes, classic d8/armor11, all three policies; separate cells, never pooled into primary

analysis.descriptive_intervals: 95% Wilson binomial and paired asymptotic-normal differences
analysis.confirmatory_intervals: Four one-sided target bounds, Bonferroni alpha=.05/4; z=2.241402727604947

selection: Training: retain classic if all adjusted target intervals match; otherwise floor4 only if all its intervals match; otherwise no-target-match. Any combat censorship prevents recommendation. Heldout never selects or retunes.
exclusions: No rows dropped, no seed replacement, no automatic repeat/pursuit, no live models, no state patches, no journal/signature assurance from pure replay
after_holdout_change: Keep all results; a changed rule/configuration requires a newly preregistered protocol/seed domain. Do not call the exposed holdout fresh evidence.
